title: Node.js · JavaScript
description: Same Prisma patterns without TypeScript — Zod at the boundaries.

prerequisites.title: Node.js · JavaScript setup
prerequisites.install: npm install @prisma/client && npm install -D prisma zod

plain-node.title: Plain Node.js API
points: Prisma/pg live in the API process
DATABASE_URL is a server env var
Expose HTTP JSON — never ship credentials to clients

react-spa.title: React SPA
points: Browser calls your API with fetch

nextjs-app-router.title: Next.js App Router
points: DB access in Server Components / Route Handlers
Prefer Node runtime for native drivers
Edge runtime lacks full pg support — use Node for Prisma

validationCatalog.title: Zod
validationCatalog.example:
const BookInsert = z.object({ title: z.string(), authorId: z.number().int() })
type BookInsert = z.infer<typeof BookInsert>

validationCatalog.title: Valibot
validationCatalog.example:
import * as v from 'valibot'
const BookInsert = v.object({ title: v.string(), authorId: v.number() })

validationCatalog.title: ArkType
validationCatalog.example:
import { type } from 'arktype'
const BookInsert = type({ title: 'string>0', authorId: 'number>0' })
